note: Fossil-revival service points, as placement DATA in the studio's placement-record style (same shape family as data/supply_placements.json: id / region / settlement / building / host_kind / spot). The service system (systems/fossil/fossil_revival_service.gd) registers these points; NO map edits are made by this prep -- the binding build places the NPC/interaction at each record's spot. Cross-region rule is sourced, not invented: the held registry's own effect text sends Kanto and Hoenn fossils to BOTH the Pewter Museum of Science and the Oreburgh Mining Museum, so every registered point revives every fossil in fossil_revival_index.json; native_items lists each point's home-generation fossils for dialogue/flavor only. building_map is given only where the map id is already established in held placement data; otherwise it is null and the settlement + building_name carry the placement until the region's world build names its map.
